title: Fix the vitals rename
prompt: This function renames `heart_rate` to `pulse` inside `vitals` and drops the temperature. But telehealth visits, which have no vitals, now come out with a struct of empty readings. Fix `solve(encounters)` so a missing `vitals` stays missing.
rules: `vitals` has the fields `systolic`, `diastolic` and `pulse` (the old `heart_rate`), in that order. `heart_rate` and `temperature_c` are gone.
A visit with no vitals keeps a missing `vitals`. A single missing reading inside stays missing.
hints: `F.struct(...)` always builds a struct, even when every value going into it is missing.
Change the existing struct instead: methods on `F.col("vitals")` leave a missing struct missing.
`withField("pulse", ...)` adds the new field at the end, and `dropFields("heart_rate", "temperature_c")` removes the old ones.
explanation: `F.struct` builds a new struct on every row, so for a visit with no `vitals` it makes one whose three fields are all missing. That isn't the same as a missing struct, and the rules want it missing. Change the existing struct instead: `F.col("vitals").withField("pulse", F.col("vitals.heart_rate")).dropFields("heart_rate", "temperature_c")`. `withField` adds `pulse` after the existing fields and `dropFields` removes the two old ones, which leaves `systolic`, `diastolic`, `pulse` in the order the rules ask. Both methods give a missing result when `vitals` is missing.
